title: decompose presubmit lanes, add dep-health reporter & fastpath lint shim
author: Aditi Shah
description: Motivation and summary: The presubmit pipeline had two issues: slow feedback for small changes (developers waited ~10-12 minutes for full lint + unit tests) and opaque dependency health signals (we relied on periodic Dependabot PRs and manual audits). This PR decomposes the presubmit pipeline into a lightweight fastpath for quick feedback and a staged full-presubmit lane, and introduces a dependency-health reporter (dep-health) that runs as part of scheduled CI and optionally posts a summary comment on PRs.
commits: a1f4c5c: introduce fastpath-lint composite action and shim for staged checks
b2d7e91: split workflow 'presubmit.yml' into presubmit-fastpath.yml and presubmit-staged.yml
c3e8b02: add dep-health CLI (go) + Dockerfile + simple report formatter
d4f9f33: wire scheduled job 'dep-health/daily' and optional PR comment opt-in label
e5a0a44: update CONTRIBUTING.md and devcontainer to document fastpath expectations
f6b1c55: add e2e smoke job to ensure staged lane compatibility with release branches
review_conversation: Jordan Kim: Left a few nits on the action inputs; suggested making timeout configurable for mono-repo slow tests.
Aditi Shah: Addressed Jordan's suggestion with input 'staged_timeout' (defaults kept to preserve existing timings).
Hector Alvarez: Asked for accuracy validation on dep-health output; requested a small test fixture and a sample HTML/plaintext reporter.
Aditi Shah: Added a fixture (tools/dep-health/testdata) and a plain-text reporter mode for quick CI artifacts. Hector approved after CI green.
Maeve Li: Concern about noise for Dependabot-remediation PRs; recommended an opt-in label for PR comments from dep-health.
Aditi Shah: Added label .github/labels/ci-opt-in.yaml and logic to only comment on PRs that include 'ci/dep-health-opt-in' or when a maintainer approves the PR.
release_notes: Split presubmit into fastpath and staged lanes to reduce feedback time for small changes (~+8m improvement on median PRs); added dep-health reporter that surfaces outdated dependencies and transitive version drift. Opt-in PR comments prevent noise on automated dependency bump PRs.
